listen_port.description: UDP port on which netconsd listens for incoming netconsole messages.

start_daemon.description: Whether to start the netconsd service at boot.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent netconsole sessions allowed.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Use '-' to log to stdout (useful for systemd journal).

log_level.description: Minimum log level for messages to be recorded.

clients.description: List of trusted netconsole clients to pre-configure for logging (optional; not required by netconsd itself but commonly used).

name.description: Human-readable identifier for the client (for comments/documentation).

ip.description: IP address of the netconsole client (source of messages).

port.description: UDP port of the client (usually same as listen_port).

mac.description: MAC address of the client interface (used for ARP assistance if needed).

iface.description: Network interface on this host to bind to for this client (empty = all).
